name: ClientAccountPlanBuilder
tagline: Key account plans, relationship maps and whitespace services – one plug-and-play Power Apps app for professional services firms.
description: Plan and govern growth in your key client accounts: current vs. target fees, a stakeholder relationship map with coverage score, a whitespace matrix of service lines with typical fees, a cross-sell pipeline and objectives & actions, with an approval workflow that checks readiness and independent approval. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, SQL or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Approval readiness checklist and independent approval
Drag & drop and keyboard pipeline moves with stage rules
Bulk send for review, approve, assign, schedule review
Phone layouts with bottom view bar
Power Fx outputs and six events
react: 16.14.0 (bundled, no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: ClientAccountPlanBuilder data-set + ClientAccountPlanBuilderPortal field control, shared src/app)
